description: Get the monthly time series of home values (ZHVI) or rents (ZORI) for a metro or state, to chart or analyze the trend.

months.description: How many recent months to return (default 24, max 360).

region.description: Metro or state name (e.g. 'Austin, TX', 'Houston', 'Texas') or a Zillow region id.

name: realestate_trend
